Home/Solutions

Built around the problems HR teams actually have.

We describe what OrgVia can do for each problem, and nothing more.

Scattered recordsEmployee information lives in too many places.

Keep profiles, employment details, reporting lines and documents in one directory, with CSV import to get started quickly.

Result: one answer when someone asks who reports to whom, or where a document is.

People features

Manual approvalsLeave and time depend on chasing people.

Employees apply against policy and balance. The approver acts on the request. Clock-in and attendance history are stored against the same employee.

Result: a trail of who requested, who approved and what was recorded.

Attendance and leave

Payroll preparationSalary details and payroll runs are hard to keep tidy.

Maintain salary records and payroll configuration, create runs from an overview, and give employees their payslips.

We would confirm the fit for your payroll rules with you in a demo before you commit.

Payroll workflows

Growing teamsHiring and onboarding are handled in separate tools.

Track jobs, candidates and interviews, then carry the person into onboarding tasks, mentors and welcome messages.

Result: the new starter already has a record on day one.

Hiring and onboarding

Access controlNot everyone should see everything.

Five roles and reporting-line scope decide what each person can see and do, and the backend enforces it. Platform-level administration is separate from organization data.

Result: managers work with their teams without wider exposure.

Roles and access

Who it suits

Organizations that have outgrown spreadsheets.

HR teams

Administer people, leave, payroll and reviews from one place.

Managers

See your own team and handle approvals without wider access.

Founders & administrators
